sloka: तस्य कल्माषपादस्य यज्ञस्यायतनं शुभम् ।आश्रमस्य समीपे ऽस्य यन्मां पृच्छसि राघव ।। ७.६५.३८ ॥
transliteration: tasya kalmāṣapādasya yajñasyāyatanaṁ śubham ।āśramasya samīpe 'sya yanmāṁ pṛcchasi rāghava ।। 7.65.38 ॥

translations.english: O Raghava, the auspicious place of sacrifice belonging to Kalmashapada, which you ask me about, is near this hermitage.
